## New professional(s) for the swarm

Entries added to `db/professionisti.json`:

- `sciame-<code>` (professional | sub-professional of `sciame-<parent>`): <name>

- [ ] Texts in every language of the repository (today Italian and English).
- [ ] The code name is new, lowercase, and not a strategy name.
- [ ] A sub-professional has a professional of the same core as parent.
- [ ] No private project details, no secrets: `python3 -I motore/sciame.py --sciame . verifica` passes.
- [ ] `sciame.sh` rebuilt: `python3 -I motore/sciame.py --sciame . costruisci --uscita sciame.sh`.
- [ ] Why: which skill the swarm lacks, and why the neighbouring roles do not cover it.
